sources.copper_um: 1 oz per square foot (IPC-4562 nominal 34.8 µm, rounded as fabricators quote it).
sources.mask_um: Within the 10–20 µm over copper that the LPI soldermask datasheets quote (Florida CirTech LPI-950 LC-1, C-8GD and S-22; docs/materials.md, Sources), toward their thin end because LPI thins over a track's crown and edges.
sources.mask_laminate_um: Uncited: Sparksmith's earlier 3D display value. LPI flows into the gaps between copper, so it is thicker over laminate than over copper, but no fabricator capability page or mask datasheet consulted states a value over laminate (docs/materials.md, Sources).
sources.two_layer_core: The common 1.6 mm double-sided build on one 7628 core.
sources.dielectric_mm: Up to ten layers the common 1.6 mm of dielectric; above that it grows by 0.16 mm a layer, as thick high-count boards do. Author's choice, not a fabricator's stackup.
sources.prepreg_mm: Foil lamination with 0.2 mm prepreg up to six layers, 0.1 mm above; thin builds use the finer glass styles. Author's choice, not a fabricator's stackup.
sources.added_prepreg: A layer added in the stackup editor: a 0.2 mm prepreg of 2116 glass or a 0.4 mm core of 7628. Author's choice.
sources.glass_dk: Generic FR-4 estimates by glass style (resin-rich thin styles lower, glass-heavy 7628 higher; typical values near 1 GHz, not a fabricator's data). Checked against Isola's published 370HR core table (docs/materials.md, Sources): 106, 1080 and 2116 agree within 0.05 (3.81, 4.04, 4.26); 7628 does not (Isola 4.36 at 42 % resin), and stays uncited until decided.
